deliverables.full_scale_run_logged.reason: The adapted run records 2,123,184 training sites, 500 stored chain states with 499 logged updates, per-block acceptance, hyperparameters, likelihoods, runtime and memory measurements. Training took 2640.12 seconds.

deliverables.test_prediction_logged.reason: Saved predictions contain all 15,000 test rows, targets, means, latent variances and observation variances. Read-only recomputation matches the logged RMSE, CRPS and coverage.

deliverables.baseline_runs_logged.reason: SVGP and VNNGP each have three completed seeds with traces, predictions and metrics. All six prediction files use exactly the adapted run's 15,000 test rows and targets.

deliverables.kernel_sparsity_visualizati.reason: Figures 1 and 2 visualize the fitted kernel, density warp, amplitude field, covariance block and support pattern. The computational profile reports 0.0041% nonzero covariance entries.

deliverables.attempts_log_present.reason: A structured attempts log records rejected domains, engineering failures, interrupted chains, unsuccessful reproduction and baseline revisions.

deliverables.methodology_section_present.reason: Methodology precedes Experimental Results and describes the methylation task, mathematical kernel, distributed banded computation, block-MCMC and prediction. Experimental Setup supplies additional run settings before results.

method_specification.domain_committed.reason: The submission commits to single-CpG methylation imputation in ENCODE HepG2 WGBS, principally chromosome 1. This is distinct from all excluded benchmarks and the climate demonstration.

method_specification.framework_is_gp2sca.reason: The implementation retains sparse distributed exact covariance computation and reference block-MCMC. Its documented specialization partitions only at certified zero-covariance gaps and uses exact banded Cholesky. A full-scale reference-fvGP comparison records likelihood agreement to 1.18×10^-15 relative error.

method_specification.kernel_adaptation_s.reason: The report specifies the catalog-derived density covariate, rank/base-pair interpolation, Wendland polynomial, amplitude field, mean and noise equations sufficiently to reimplement them. Their motivation is the density-dependent correlation and heterogeneous read depth of methylation data.

method_specification.test_split_pre_stat.reason: Preparation records begin at 05:25:48 UTC for chromosome 21 and 05:26:53 for chromosome 1, before their training. Test membership is drawn before training rows are selected. The unchanged plan committing the definition and seed is timestamped 05:37:04, before the full-scale run began around 06:00.

method_specification.metric_pre_stated.reason: The committed plan specifies RMSE, Gaussian CRPS and a 5%-95% probability-coverage curve before the full-scale run. Earlier pilot work does not violate this preregistration deadline.

scale_floor.full_scale_achieved.reason: The completed adapted run uses exactly the committed 2,123,184 training sites, exceeding 500,000. The processed-data mask independently confirms this count.

scale_floor.solve_at_full_scale.reason: The run has subset=0, and every likelihood evaluation sums exact solves and log-determinants over certified independent segments covering the entire training set. Hyperparameters are updated using that full likelihood; the full-scale equivalence record corroborates it.

kernel_contribution.kernel_differs_from_.reason: The learned interpolation between genomic distance and catalog rank, coupled to a density-dependent amplitude and a monotone-support certificate, changes both covariance geometry and computation. It is a substantive domain construction beyond retuning a stock Wendland bandwidth.

kernel_contribution.existing_kernel_inad.reason: On identical full-scale data and test sites, stationary Wendland has RMSE 0.248345 and CRPS 0.136773 versus 0.244841 and 0.134134 for the adaptation. Island RMSE improves from 0.170299 to 0.149169. The convolution reference also performs worse. This establishes inadequacy of the tested references, without proving every possible original-family parameterization inadequate.

kernel_contribution.adaptation_motivated.reason: The adaptation directly represents correlation over neighboring CpG sites, variation in local site density, compartment-dependent residual amplitude and read-depth-dependent measurement variability.

kernel_contribution.domain_warrants_new_.reason: Although genomic position is one-dimensional, the data exhibit substantial density-dependent nonstationarity and heterogeneous observation noise. The logged compartment differences and bandwidth contrast of 51 versus 340 show that this is not a trivially smooth stationary Euclidean example.

insight_contribution.insight_present.reason: The submission goes beyond baseline scores: it identifies a preference for CpG-index geometry and uses paired libraries to distinguish reproducible site variation from read-sampling variability. The fitted metric and replicate-discrepancy statistics provide substantive domain findings.

insight_contribution.insight_grounded_in.reason: Chains, compartment residuals and replicate records ground the empirical findings. Stronger claims of sharply established posterior certainty, a universal neighborhood-imputation floor and biological causation exceed that support. The same chromosome-21 dataset gives last-half gamma means 0.810-0.885 across seeds, with differing intervals, and the full-scale noise parameter is still drifting toward its prior bound.

comparison_quality.reproduction_faithful.reason: The required MNIST dataset, 60,000/10,000 split, high-dimensional distance computation and sparse reference solvers are exercised across three seeds, providing partial implementation evidence. However, Brier 0.0790±0.0021 is far outside 0.018±0.006, and the production reproduction uses kW without the paper's delta factor. Neither the 0.0310 diagnostic nor methylome equivalence satisfies the mandated score match.

comparison_quality.test_set_held_out_pro.reason: The frozen test set has 15,000 sites, exceeding min(1% of 2,123,184, 10,000)=10,000. Its definition and seed are documented, preparation precedes training, and training rows are selected afterward. Saved membership exactly matches the specified seeded draw.

comparison_quality.baseline_genuine_effo.reason: At least one baseline meets the substantive tuning-and-scale requirement: SVGP trains on all 2,123,184 sites after an eight-configuration validation search over inducing count, features and noise treatment, followed by three seeds. The submission also fixes an identified feature-scaling defect and extends undertrained VNNGP runs to 30 epochs.

comparison_quality.quality_metric_compet.reason: Against the completed baselines, the adapted run's RMSE 0.24484 and reported CRPS 0.13413 are substantially lower than SVGP's 0.38043±0.00111 and 0.22317±0.00090, and VNNGP's 0.42221±0.00059 and 0.24848±0.00033. The differences greatly exceed observed baseline seed variation.

metric_reporting.modern_metrics_reported.reason: All six main-table methods have RMSE and CRPS values, coverage summaries and 19-level probability-coverage curves. Figure 5 includes the adaptation, both existing kernels, the ablation and both approximate baselines.

metric_reporting.baseline_metrics_recomp.reason: The existing-kernel runs have their own saved predictions and recomputed RMSE, CRPS and coverage on the identical test set, enabling direct comparison with the adaptation.

mechanism_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Analysis contains an explicit mechanism subsection.
evidence: proposal/report.tex:601-626, subsection 'Mechanism: why the warp captures what coordinates cannot'

mechanism_analysis.mechanism_explains_ke.reason: For the tested references, the argument coherently links the warp to density-dependent physical reach while keeping support compact in site order. Compartment errors, the observation-model ablation and bandwidth measurements connect the construction to its predictive and computational advantages.

failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Analysis includes a dedicated 'Failure modes and limitations' subsection.

failure_analysis.patterns_identified.reason: Specific documented weaknesses include island overcoverage, continued noise-parameter drift, higher point error in open sea, and expensive physical-distance reference kernels. Island coverage is 0.971 for the adaptation versus nominal 0.900.

failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: The main explanations are principled: a compartment-independent nugget gives excessive uncertainty in quiet islands, weak separation of noise components permits parameter drift, and wider covariance bandwidth raises factorization cost. These explanations align with the reported compartment and trace diagnostics.

scaling_analysis.subsection_present.reason: The Analysis explicitly discusses support bandwidth, the 768-site budget, zero budget rejections and the runtime penalty of the stationary and convolution kernels.

scaling_analysis.sparsity_scaling_discus.reason: The report explains O(Nb) assembly/storage and O(Nb²) factorization and relates feasibility to measured bandwidths and a bandwidth cap. Saved runs at 50,000, 343,145 and 2,123,184 sites provide supporting timing evidence. A controlled scaling sweep is not required by this criterion.

originality_and_literature.contribution_.reason: The methylome-specific metric, exact banded specialization and replicate analysis add substantive scientific content. The mathematical ingredients extend established input warping, amplitude modulation and compact-support inference; the evidence does not establish the broader claim that covariate-driven structure lies outside the original paper's arbitrary nonstationary/core-kernel constructions.
evidence: proposal/report.tex, references Risser and Calder (2015), Snoek et al. (2014), and Noack et al. (2023, 2025)

originality_and_literature.literature_en.reason: The report meaningfully connects methylation smoothing and imputation, co-methylation/processivity studies, nonstationary covariance design, large-scale exact GPs and variational approximations. Engagement extends well beyond the source paper.

originality_and_literature.spec_independ.reason: The title, scientific motivation, kernel development and main analysis are organized around methylation geometry and site variability. The manuscript reads as a domain contribution despite including required reproduction and comparison material.

writing_quality.journal_quality_structur.reason: The manuscript is coherent, substantive and predominantly prose, with clear methods and quantitative results. It falls short of journal-level polish through an extended audit-style reproduction discussion, overly strong causal/universal interpretations, and figures dispersed through the reference section.

writing_quality.limitations_discussion_p.reason: The explicit limitations discussion covers noise-component identifiability, compartmental miscalibration, computational support budgets, MCMC cost, restricted biological scope and the Gaussian approximation to binomial observations.

writing_quality.rendered_pdf_clean.reason: All 14 rendered pages were visually inspected. Equations, tables and figures fit their pages, and no clipping, broken references or overlapping content was observed. Float placement is awkward but does not break the rendered objects.
evidence: proposal/report.pdf, page 6 main table and pages 10-13 figures

writing_quality.main_results_table_compl.reason: Every required method row and all nine prescribed columns are populated with numerical results or kernel descriptions; there are no placeholder cells.
